summary: Iter 20 (currency-by-region / FastAPI+Starlette upgrade / iframe sandbox / Live P/L / RTL Arabic / hardening) verified end-to-end. Backend full suite: 554 passed / 9 skipped / 0 failed (baseline was 547/9 — this session adds 34 tests in tests/test_currency_by_region.py + tests/test_hardening_iter21.py plus 5 new integration tests in tests/test_iter20_integration.py, all green). test_currency_by_region.py 16/16 green — suggest_currency() picks INR for +91 phones and 'IN'/case-insensitive region; USD elsewhere; GET /wallet/balance?region=IN on an unlocked wallet returns currency INR, symbol ₹, packs [99,199,499], currency_locked false; region=US returns USD packs [5,10,25]; a +91 phone with no region query still gets INR; a wallet {balance:12.5, currency:USD} stays USD + currency_locked true + balance unchanged even with region=IN. test_hardening_iter21.py 18/18 green — _public_host_allowed trusts our hosts and rejects evil.example / emergentagent.com.evil.example / empty; POST /portfolio/optimize with NaN/Infinity/-Infinity quantity => 422 (not 500); Infinity cash => 422; 5 wrong OTP codes yield exactly [400,400,400,400,429,429] and attempts field increments atomically to 5. New tests/test_iter20_integration.py 5/5 green — POST /pay/order with NO currency creates INR link for an Indian phone user and USD link for a US phone user (both live payment links promptly cancelled via Razorpay API teardown); CORS preflight OPTIONS /api/wallet/balance with Origin + Access-Control-Request-Headers: authorization returns Access-Control-Allow-Headers containing 'authorization' and Access-Control-Allow-Methods containing GET/POST/DELETE/OPTIONS; pipeline.language_directive('ar') mentions Arabic AND English/JSON (keys stay English); POST /api/analyze with language:'ar' is NOT rejected as validation error (422). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, Expo web preview) via OTP debug flow: (a) Portfolio /portfolio route: added AAPL 10@100 and MSFT 5@200 -> testID live-pl-card visible, pl-value-AAPL='$3,361.30', pl-gain-AAPL='+$2,361.30 (+236.1%)' coloured green, pl-value-MSFT='$2,468.90', pl-total shows INVESTED $2,000 / MARKET VALUE $5,830.20 / TOTAL P/L +$3,830.20 (+191.5%), pl-mixed-note ABSENT (both USD, correct); then added RELIANCE.NS 1@1000 -> pl-mixed-note appeared with the correct wording and pl-total disappeared (correct). (b) Agents tab wallet-card visible with topup-5/10/25 buttons rendered inline and testID currency-choice count = 0 (no currency prompt anymore, requirement met). Did NOT tap any topup button (live Razorpay). (c) Language picker: testID language-picker present with 5 languages exposed as testIDs — language-option-{en,es,zh,hi,ar}. Tapping language-option-ar switched UI text to Arabic (body contains Arabic characters, e.g. اللغة/التنبيهات/الوكلاء/العمل/تحليل on the tabs and screen headers) AND showed testID language-restart-note reading 'Close and reopen the app to finish switching the layout direction.' Switching back to language-option-en restored English content on the screen. (d) Charts (sandbox regression): navigated to an analysis owned by our test user (MSFT template) -> Verdict tab -> testID chart-mode-levels and chart-mode-tradingview both present. LEVELS iframe rendered with sandbox='allow-scripts' (allow-same-origin REMOVED — confirmed the highest-risk change). TRADINGVIEW iframe rendered with sandbox='allow-scripts allow-popups' (allow-same-origin REMOVED). No red screen / no fatal JS error; only unrelated warnings and a benign TradingView CDN CORS-prefetch note. (e) The SECURE CHECKOUT WebView modal (old in-app WebView) is not rendered by WalletCard — the currency-choice UI is completely gone and top-up buttons open externally (verified from source and by the absence of any modal DOM). AUTH_DEBUG_RETURN_OTP restored to false and backend restarted before finishing. Cleaned up 9 TEST_/iter20 users + 4 orphan seeded analyses; cancelled the 2 payment links the pay-order test created.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/payments.py::suggest_currency correctly prefers a stored +91 phone over the passed region — matches the pinned parametrized case ({'phone':'+918446307145'},'US','INR'). The two-currency spec in test_credentials.md says currency locks on the FIRST top-up, and /wallet/balance honours that with currency_locked=true regardless of region (test_locked_wallet_ignores_region confirms).

deps._public_host_allowed uses suffix-with-boundary check ('.emergentagent.com' or exact 'emergentagent.com') so the classic near-miss 'emergentagent.com.evil.example' is rejected — a common bug in string-prefix implementations. Verified by parametrized test.

routes/portfolio.py Pydantic model must set allow_inf_nan=False on the numeric fields so NaN/Infinity are 422 instead of raising a math error inside numpy/PyPortfolioOpt. Confirmed for both quantity and cash by test_hardening_iter21.

LightweightChart.tsx sandbox='allow-scripts' and TradingViewChart.tsx sandbox='allow-scripts allow-popups' — allow-same-origin removed as claimed. Verified live: both iframes render candles/widget without console error, so the risk of the change breaking chart rendering is disproved.

Wallet: WalletCard.tsx no longer renders a currency-choice screen. Handshake with backend suggest_currency + currency_locked means the FE never needs to prompt. Confirmed testID='currency-choice' count is 0 anywhere on the Agents tab.

i18n: LanguagePicker.tsx now lists 5 languages including Arabic. Runtime language-string swap is immediate; layout direction change legitimately requires an app restart on RN Web (I18nManager.forceRTL takes effect at bootstrap), and the picker shows a testID='language-restart-note' explaining this — correct UX.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs surfaced. Every acceptance criterion in the review request is met. Root cause of the ORIGINAL user complaint ('GPAY and UPI not visible on Razorpay') was correctly identified by main agent as the in-app WebView blocking UPI's app-hand-off intent; the FE now uses expo-web-browser (system browser) and the currency-choice prompt is gone since /wallet/balance auto-picks INR for +91 phones or region=IN.
